name: Cloudflare DDNS
description: A lightweight C client that keeps a Cloudflare DNS A record aligned with a changing public IP address. It compares the current address with the configured record and updates it when needed, with systemd units for scheduled execution.

name: Decoder RV32I Game
description: An interactive terminal game for learning how RISC-V RV32I instructions are encoded. It turns assembly instructions into practical questions about opcodes, formats, and registers, tracking the player's score as they learn.

name: Tang Nano 20K Labs
description: A Linux-based FPGA development environment for the Sipeed Tang Nano 20K. The repository provides documented labs, simulation, synthesis, and flashing workflows using open-source and Gowin toolchains.

name: KSP DMP Docker Server
description: A Docker image for running a Kerbal Space Program multiplayer server with DarkMultiPlayer. It automates setup, handles persistent server data and permissions, and is designed for integration with server-management platforms.

name: Hytale Dedicated Server Docker
description: A configurable Docker environment for hosting a Hytale dedicated server. It automates server downloads and updates while exposing settings for authentication, backups, resources, and persistent game data.

name: NoDDNS
description: A self-managed dynamic DNS solution that synchronizes a home connection's public IP with a remote server. A shell client reports changes to a token-protected Node.js API, which updates the target host automatically.

name: TripConnect API
description: A REST API for travel destinations and traveler testimonials, built as Alura's seventh Back-End Challenge. It combines a Node.js and Express backend with MySQL persistence through Sequelize and OpenAI-powered destination insights.

name: Crun
description: A small Linux command-line utility that compiles and runs C or C++ source files through a single command, simplifying the edit-build-run cycle for small programs and exercises.
